_metadata.description: Header-comment-driven indexer that walks the components root and upserts a SQLite-backed registry of shared UI primitives.

requirements.title: Indexer walks the configured components root and parses @libraryId header comments
requirements.description: On startup and on `react-component-library components index`, the indexer enumerates *.tsx files under the resolver-scoped components root, parses the `@libraryId`/`@displayName`/`@description`/`@version`/`@sourcePath`/`@warning`/`@deps` header comment, and upserts a row into `components` + `component_headers` in SQLite.

validation.notes: Repository test in api/internal/components/sqlite_test.go covers upsert/update/delete on indexer runs; service-level test asserts walk + parse against a synthetic root.

requirements.title: Missing or malformed header comments reject with a structured error
requirements.description: If a candidate file omits required header fields or has a malformed `@deps` JSON, the indexer surfaces a structured `IndexerError{Path, Line, Field, Reason}` rather than silently skipping. CLI `components index` exits non-zero when any error is present; default human output prints one line per error.

validation.notes: Indexer test feeds files with each failure mode and asserts the structured error shape.

requirements.title: Header-parse regex tolerates leading `/**` and `*` indentation
requirements.description: The parser must accept the canonical JSDoc-style header (block comment, leading `*` per line) and a single-line `//` form for `@libraryId` only; whitespace tolerance must not let undelimited fields bleed into adjacent fields.

validation.notes: Parser test in api/internal/components/parser_test.go covers JSDoc, single-line, mixed-whitespace, and bleed-prevention cases.
